_note: Arcana Unleashed (2024) backgrounds — 10 (nine tied to chapter 4 magical factions, plus Familiar Trainer). Each raises 3 ability scores, grants an AU Origin feat, 2 skills, 1 tool, and an equipment package (or 50 GP). Descriptions are an original paraphrase of flavor; source 'arcana-unleashed'.

backgrounds.name: Agent of the Ninth Quill
equipment: Dagger, Light Hammer, Thieves' Tools, Iron Spikes, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 17 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Your sharp mind and burgling skill drew you into the Ninth Quill, a collective of thieves and spies who steal magical lore and relics. Purloining tomes and sabotaging mages, you honed cunning tricks to further your spy craft.

backgrounds.name: Bejeweled Conclave Spy
equipment: Disguise Kit, Fine Clothes, Perfume, 5 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Publicly a courtier or entertainer, you are privately a gatherer of secrets. Trained by the enchanters of the Bejeweled Conclave, you use charm, wit, and a little magic to infiltrate, uncover information, and broker deals.

backgrounds.name: Cosmic Dawn Experiment
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools
equipment: Artisan's Tools (same as above), Backpack, Robe, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Your body has been warped by the transmutation practices of the Bringers of the Cosmic Dawn — whether caught in an experiment or seeking to perfect your form. Now you turn your strange anatomy to your advantage.

backgrounds.name: Covenant of the Grave Recruit
equipment: Dagger, Herbalism Kit, Book (anatomy), Shovel, 16 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Death has always fascinated you. Studying it with the Covenant of the Grave, you analyzed the macabre with scientific precision and amassed knowledge of medicine, necromancy, and history.

backgrounds.name: Crucible Storm Chaser
equipment: Glassblower's Tools, Backpack, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 15 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Your thirst for excitement led you to the Crucible Keepers, who study natural and magical catastrophes. From molten glass to the eye of a hurricane, you thrive when disaster is mere steps away.

backgrounds.name: Familiar Trainer
toolProficiencies: Choose one kind of Gaming Set
equipment: Quarterstaff, Gaming Set (same as above), Bedroll, Bell, String, Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, Waterskin, 44 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: A magical familiar bonded with you in youth and became inseparable. Working in tandem with your furry (or feathery, scaly, or slimy) friend, you face adventure together — and it never lets you forget the small joys in life.

backgrounds.name: Horizon Weaver Initiate
equipment: Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Weaver's Tools, Map, Quiver, Rope, Traveler's Clothes, 18 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Unquenchable wanderlust set you traveling young. Along the way the adventurous conjurers of the Horizon Weavers taught you some of their teleportation magic to further your explorations.

backgrounds.name: Phantasmic Circus Trouper
equipment: Disguise Kit, Gaming Set (any), Costume, Mirror, Traveler's Clothes, 12 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: As performer or circus hand, you found a home with the Phantasmic Circus. Traveling the world bringing wonder to audiences, you picked up illusion magic and a talent for performance and misdirection.

backgrounds.name: Seer Apprentice
equipment: Navigator's Tools, 8 Candles, Ink, Ink Pen, Parchment (9 sheets), Pouch, Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, 11 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Among the Seers of Sea and Sky you learned to read minor omens in the clouds above and the fathoms below. Educated by the order's libraries, you now travel the world imparting advice and aid.

backgrounds.name: Ward of the Sheltering Hands
equipment: Cook's Utensils, Blanket, Healer's Kit, Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, Waterskin, 40 GP
or 50 GP
backgrounds.description: Ill luck led you to the Sheltering Hands, an altruistic order that defends the downtrodden. They helped you find your footing and taught you protective magic, in hope that one day you would shelter others in need.
